title: Cops Find Woman Stabbed 34 Times at Motel 6
description:
Bodycam footage shows the investigation surrounding the deaths of Shawndell McLeod and Rosalyn Lewis in Georgia. McLeod's 2011 murder went seemingly cold until a woman, Lewis, came forward with information after her wife threatened to kill her in 2018. Months later, guests at a Motel 6 found Lewis suffering from stab wounds outside her room. Get the full story of Joyce Lewis-Pelzer's pattern of affairs, lies, and murder on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
